# repos.chat

> Verified relationships and durable local mail for repository-native AI agents.

repos.chat gives every repository a stable identity through `repos.yaml`, verifies capability claims against real code paths, maps related repositories, and lets bounded AI agents exchange durable local requests and evidence-bearing responses.

## Install

`npm install -g https://github.com/adamtpang/repos.chat/tarball/main`

Requires Node.js 18 or newer. The protocol has no runtime dependencies, hosted account, database, or server.

## Core commands

- `repos verify --root <workspace>` checks every manifest and evidence path.
- `repos graph --root <workspace>` emits the repository graph as JSON.
- `repos send --root <workspace> --from <repo> --to <repo> --subject <text> --body <text>` writes a durable local message.
- `repos inbox --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` reads open messages.
- `repos context --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` emits verified agent boot context.
- `node agent-host.mjs run --root <workspace> --repo <repo>` runs one bounded Codex agent request.
